change: Add an Over or under mode to the trapezoid workshop

mutations.name: the call follows which way the curve goes, not how it bends
the inside heights are not doubled
any falling curve counts as overshot
a curve that bends down is said to have tops above it
mutations.find: so the curve bends down and each straight top runs below it
mutations.replace: so the curve bends down and each straight top runs above it

mutations.name: a call still moves once the round is right
gaps are rounded to two places
mutations.find:
fx(v){ const r=Math.round(v*1000)/1000; return r===0 ? '0' : neg(+r.toFixed(3)); },
  strips
mutations.replace:
fx(v){ const r=Math.round(v*100)/100; return r===0 ? '0' : neg(+r.toFixed(3)); },
  strips
